scripts.cloudflare-build: opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && cp -r .open-next/cloudflare .open-next/assets/ && cp -r .open-next/server-functions .open-next/assets/ && cp -r .open-next/middleware .open-next/assets/ && cp -r .open-next/.build .open-next/assets/ && cp .open-next/worker.js .open-next/assets/_worker.js && echo '{"version":1,"include":["/*"],"exclude":["/_next/static/*","/images/*","/favicon.ico","/robots.txt","/sitemap.xml","/icon.jpg"]}' > .open-next/assets/_routes.json
